transcript.speaker: Giselle Rousseau
transcript.content: Dad, can I say something quickly? When you use that dismissive tone with me, especially in front of my child, it really makes me feel undermined. I’d appreciate it if you could speak to me more respectfully — I want our kid to learn good communication and I don’t want to make tonight into a fight.

transcript.content: Giselle, I'm sorry — I didn't realize my tone was coming off dismissive. I hear you and I'll make a conscious effort to speak to you more respectfully, especially around your child. If I slip up, please call me out; I want our kid to learn from how we handle things.
